insurer_note: Old Mutual life business in Kenya (formerly UAP Old Mutual; life merger with Old Mutual Assurance Company reported by Capital FM/The EastAfrican). Ownership detail not verified from a page I opened.

products.name: Elimika Education Plan
products.summary: Regular-premium school-fee plan: save over an accumulation period, then receive guaranteed education payouts, with a guaranteed death benefit during the term.
products.target_client: Parents/guardians funding a child's school fees
products.how_it_works: Accumulation period then payout period; payouts monthly, quarterly, half-yearly or annually.
benefits: Child protected if parent dies in term
products.payment_options: M-Pesa, Airtel Money, direct debit, check-off, standing order, cheque, bank deposit
products.waiting_periods_or_exclusions: No death benefit for death from war/terrorism, radioactivity/nuclear explosion, intentional drug/alcohol intake, or violation of criminal law by the life assured
analysis_selling_points: Guaranteed payouts (per page) suit fee-timing needs
Waiver rider protects the plan if payer dies
analysis_watch_outs: Entry age and sum assured not published; get from quote
Confirm what 'guaranteed' covers and surrender terms

products.name: Lengo Savings Plan
products.summary: Monthly-premium savings plan with life cover, up to 20 years, with a premiums-back guarantee at maturity (per Sept 2026 coverage) and partial access to savings.
products.target_client: People saving for a home, business, wedding or long-term security who also want dependants covered
products.how_it_works: Monthly premiums, optional lump sums, term chosen up to 20 years; automatic premium holiday up to six months.
benefits: Guarantee of at least premiums paid if held to maturity
products.term_or_duration: Up to 20 years; no minimum stated
products.payment_options: M-Pesa, Airtel Money, direct debit, check-off, standing order, cheque, bank deposit
products.waiting_periods_or_exclusions: No death benefit for death from war/terrorism, radioactivity/nuclear explosion, intentional drug/alcohol intake, or violation of criminal law by the life assured
analysis_selling_points: Premiums-back floor at maturity addresses fear of losing capital
Flexibility via top-ups and premium holiday
analysis_watch_outs: Early surrender can return little or nothing per secondary article; show surrender values
Charges and new surrender terms not published; entry age not stated
products.source_note: Old Mutual product page; the 2026-09-25 tech-ish.com article (secondary) for the premiums-back guarantee and recent term change.

products.name: Lengo Education Plan
products.summary: Long-term savings plan for a child's education with life cover equal to future gross premiums (free cover limit KES 1.2m) and annual benefits in the last 4 years.
products.target_client: Parents/guardians with insurable interest in the nominated child
products.how_it_works: Fund value payable at maturity; in last 4 years take 20% of fund value at each anniversary; 15% of savings accessible from a Short Term Pocket.
benefits: Life cover = sum of future gross premiums, free cover limit KES 1,200,000
products.waiting_periods_or_exclusions: Not listed; underwriting and age limits apply

products.name: Lengo Digital Savings Plan
products.summary: All-digital savings plan with regular or lump-sum contributions, a two-year lock-in and life cover of 30% of fund value capped at KES 500,000.
products.target_client: Individuals saving for personal goals; can be opened for children with ID and guardianship proof
products.how_it_works: Start online; pause, adjust or stop contributions; money invested with 2-year lock-in.
key_features: Life cover 30% of fund, max KES 500,000
products.min_premium_or_sum_assured: KES 3,000 per month or KES 300,000 one-time
products.waiting_periods_or_exclusions: Cover pays immediately for accidental death, after 3 months for non-accidental; suicide excluded in first 2 years; also war, nuclear, criminal activity, drugs/alcohol, fraud
analysis_selling_points: Built-in cover with no medicals stated
analysis_watch_outs: Cover scales with fund so is small early on

products.name: Hakika Savings Plan
products.summary: Regular-premium endowment-style savings paid as a lump sum at term end, with guaranteed death benefit and premium waiver.
products.how_it_works: Premiums monthly, quarterly, annually or single; accumulated savings paid at maturity.
benefits: Premium waiver on death or disability
riders_options: Optional life cover equal to 10% of face value
products.payment_options: M-Pesa, Airtel Money, direct debit, check-off, standing order, cheque, bank deposit
products.waiting_periods_or_exclusions: No death benefit for death from war/terrorism, radioactivity/nuclear explosion, intentional drug/alcohol intake, or violation of criminal law by the life assured
analysis_selling_points: Lowest minimum among Old Mutual endowments seen
analysis_watch_outs: Check surrender values; returns not published

products.name: Rafiki Halisi Investment Plan
products.summary: Unit-linked plan combining investment and term life cover; maturity depends on market performance.
products.how_it_works: Units accumulate; life cover is 10 times monthly contributions.
key_features: Premium holiday up to 6 months per 5 years
benefits: Full unit fund at maturity less charges
15% tax relief capped at KES 5,000 per month
analysis_watch_outs: Premium cap of KES 6,500 limits large savers

products.name: Whole Life Cover (Greenlight Whole Life Assurance)
products.summary: Pays the sum assured on death from natural causes or accident; minimum cover KES 1m with premiums payable to age 80.
products.min_premium_or_sum_assured: Minimum cover KES 1m, no maximum; premium by cover
products.waiting_periods_or_exclusions: Suicide and violation of criminal law
analysis_watch_outs: Premium and cash-value details not published

products.name: Life Term Cover
products.summary: Lump sum to beneficiaries if the life assured dies within the term; minimum cover KES 1m.
products.waiting_periods_or_exclusions: No death benefit for death from war/terrorism, radioactivity/nuclear explosion, intentional drug/alcohol intake, or violation of criminal law by the life assured
analysis_watch_outs: Entry age and rates not published

products.name: Last Expense Cover
products.summary: Family funeral cover with cash paid within 48 hours; single or multiple claim options; sum assured KES 50,000-500,000.
products.target_client: Principal, spouse, up to 4 children (5 for single parents); extras can be added
products.how_it_works: Single claim cover lapses after first claim; multiple claim up to 3 per year; annual renewal.
products.entry_age: Principal, spouse, parents up to 75; children to 18 (24 if in school)
products.term_or_duration: Whole of life with annual renewal

products.name: Diaspora Last Expense
products.summary: USD-denominated funeral cover for diaspora members covering family in Kenya, including repatriation costs.
products.how_it_works: Nuclear or Extended Family options; USD payout.
products.entry_age: Principal/spouse to 60 (ends 75); parents to 75 (ends 85); children 3 months-18 (24 in school)
products.waiting_periods_or_exclusions: Accidental none; natural 3 months; suicide 2 years

products.name: Personal Pension Plan (Old Mutual Individual Retirement Benefits Scheme)
products.summary: RBA-regulated individual pension with variable contributions, 1.25% annual fee and no withdrawal penalties.
products.target_client: Individuals incl. those not employed; can consolidate old benefits
products.min_premium_or_sum_assured: Minimum not stated; tax-deductible up to 30% of pay or KES 20,000 per month
products.payment_options: M-Pesa paybill, bank transfer, cash deposit

products.name: Group Last Expense Cover
products.summary: Employer-sponsored funeral cover paying a lump sum within 48 hours, with free cover limit and wellness clinics.
products.waiting_periods_or_exclusions: Excludes war, riots, suicide, alcohol/drugs, hazardous sports, racing
